references.text: Describes the actual event where Jesus calls out to Lazarus and he comes out of the tomb, as the people testify in this verse.
States that many of the Jews who had seen what Jesus did with Lazarus believed in him, which is the context for the people testifying.
Describes how the chief priests and Pharisees gather because of the signs Jesus performed, including the raising of Lazarus, as the people testify.
States that a large crowd of Jews came to see both Jesus and the raised Lazarus, and that others went away to see him, confirmed by the people in this verse.
Explains that the reason the people went out to meet Jesus was because they had heard about the sign he performed (the raising of Lazarus), which they testify to here.
